title: Transport of a vertical square-pasting equation through coherent comparisons
statement:
Let $A,B,C,D,E,F$ and $A',B',C',D',E',F'$ be categories, with functors $E_X:X\to X'$ for the six corresponding pairs. Let $K:A\to B$, $I:C\to D$, $J:E\to F$, $P_1:D\to B$, $P_2:F\to D$, $P_{12}:F\to B$, $R_1:C\to A$, $R_2:E\to C$, $R_{12}:E\to A$, and let primed functors have the corresponding primed endpoints. Use the natural-transformation square notation of [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], without requiring adjunctions. For functors $E_X:X\to X'$ and $F:X\to Y$ equipped with an invertible natural comparison $e_F:E_YF\simeq F'E_X$, put $e_{HF}=(H'e_F)\circ(e_HF)$ for a composite $HF$. For a cell $t:F\to H$ with the same endpoints, say it is respected if $e_H\circ E_Y(t)=(t'E_X)\circ e_F$. All compositions below are in the usual right-to-left order, with the canonical functor associators inserted. Choose comparisons $e_K,e_I,e_J,e_{P_1},e_{P_2},e_{P_{12}},e_{R_1},e_{R_2},e_{R_{12}}$. Let $c_P:P_{12}\simeq P_1P_2$, $c_R:R_{12}\simeq R_1R_2$ and primed counterparts satisfy $e_{P_1P_2}\circ E_B(c_P)=(c'_PE_F)\circ e_{P_{12}}$ and $e_{R_1R_2}\circ E_A(c_R)=(c'_RE_E)\circ e_{R_{12}}$. Let $a:P_1I\to KR_1$, $b:P_2J\to IR_2$, $c:P_{12}J\to KR_{12}$ and primed counterparts be respected cells. If
$$ (a'R'_2)\circ(P'_1b')\circ(c'_PJ')=(K'c'_R)\circ c',$$
then for every $N\in E$,
$$ E_B\big(((aR_2)\circ(P_1b)\circ(c_PJ))_N\big)=E_B\big(((Kc_R)\circ c)_N\big).$$
No faithfulness or equivalence of $E_X$ is assumed.
